caption:
Figure 3: Overview of Classwise State Routing. Top: A labeled calibration set estimates down-
stream class-by-state reliability, selects a compact shared state pool, and fixes class-conditioned
routing weights. Bottom: For a new image, the frozen backbone extracts selected-state responses,
which are fused and rescaled before unchanged backend-native decoding.
delegated_acceptance_review: Reviewed complete final image and caption. Six calibration steps, fixed selected state pool and class weights, original formulas and input/class response examples, fusion/scaling/backend ordering are intact. New calibration/inference banners correctly describe fixed weights reused for a new image before unchanged decoding, without altering original heatmap or class encodings. Complete original rectangle independently replayed native.
